info.title: ExpenseFlow Core Case Service API v1
info.description: Version 1 contract for Core Case Service endpoints. Fields are never removed or changed silently within v1: a field is first marked deprecated with a migration note and remains supported until a future API version. Per-tenant rate limits apply to bearer-authenticated routes; pre-authentication endpoints require separate abuse controls because submitted tenant identifiers are not trusted.

RateLimitLimit.description: Maximum tenant requests in the current window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Tenant requests remaining in the current window.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the current tenant window resets.

RateLimitCost.description: Request units charged for this API call.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the tenant may retry the request.

RateLimitExceeded.description: The authenticated tenant request limit was exceeded.

put.summary: Upload a receipt to a Drafted Expense Report
put.description: Stores receipt bytes for the authenticated Employee's own Drafted Expense Report before its metadata is attached to a line item.

post.summary: Add line items and receipt references to a draft

409.description: Expense content can only be added while the report is Drafted.

get.summary: Get saved content from a draft
get.description: Returns saved line items, receipt metadata, and mileage entries from the authenticated Employee's own Drafted Expense Report.

get.summary: Get an employee submission's line items and mileage
get.description: Returns line items and mileage only when the Expense Report belongs to the authenticated Employee within the authenticated tenant.
